claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cinacalcet is a calcimimetic that allosterically activates the calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) with high potency (EC50 ~30-50 nM); at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its pharmacology is receptor-mediated modulation of PTH/calcitonin secretion rather than direct cell killing.
